sentences.text: One home-loan agreement states that on pre-payment or foreclosure the borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding, and the schedule repeats 2% of principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure. [fact]
The bank’s own documents do not all match, because another home-loan agreement says 3%, and the key facts statement says pre-payment / foreclosure charges are Nil. [conflict]
For Rs 10,00,000 prepaid at 2%, the charge is {{calc:1}}. [calc]
